title: WCAG 2.1 AA — keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and color contrast audit
description: Audit the app for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance and fix critical issues: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, focus management, and color contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements reachable via Tab key
Focus ring visible on all focused elements (no outline: none without replacement)
All images have alt text (or aria-hidden if decorative)
All form inputs have associated labels
Modal dialogs trap focus when open (shadcn/ui handles this)
ARIA roles on custom components (e.g., timeline, notification list)
Color contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text, ≥ 3:1 for large text
No content relies on color alone to convey meaning

steps.details: Install axe-playwright or axe-core. Run axe audit on main pages: landing, login, register, dashboard, project detail (each tab), settings, public share page. Log all violations.

Tab through the app. Fix any: missing tabindex, focus jumping to wrong element, focus not returning to trigger after dialog closes. Ensure drag-and-drop list items have keyboard alternatives (arrow key reorder).

Add aria-label to: icon-only buttons (e.g., delete, drag handle, close), the notification bell, the theme toggle, the progress bar (aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax). Add role='list' and role='listitem' to custom lists.
Use browser DevTools accessibility panel or a contrast checker tool. Check all muted text colors against their backgrounds. Fix any failures — usually by darkening text or lightening background.
Complete the main user flow using only keyboard: login, create project, add milestone, complete todo, log journal entry. Verify all actions are achievable without a mouse.

technicalNotes: shadcn/ui components are built on Radix UI which handles most WCAG requirements out of the box
Common issues: custom dropdown menus, drag-and-drop interfaces, and toast notifications need extra ARIA work
Test with real screen readers (VoiceOver on Mac, NVDA on Windows) for a full a11y check
